# 1 Exam Prep Electrician Exam Prep

> 2026 journeyman and master electrician exam prep packages for all 50 US states, built on the 2026 National Electrical Code. Study guides, flash cards, NEC code books with pre-printed tabs, calculations guides and online practice exams. Buy buttons go straight to checkout at 1examprep.com. Phone (877) 775-9400, email sales@1examprep.com.

## How the site is organised

- `/` picks a state and a level (Journeyman or Master).
- `/<state>/<journeyman|master>/<year>/` lists that combination's packages (multi-word states use a dash, e.g. `/new-york/`; `/general/` is the non-state edition).
- `/<state>/<level>/<year>/<package>/` is a full product page. Package slugs: study-guide-flash-cards, study-guide-nec-tabs, study-guide-calculations-nec, super-combo, ultimate-combo (and study-guide-nec on the general edition).
- Packages per state and level, lowest to highest: Study Guide + Flash Cards ($99.95), Study Guide + NEC with Tabs ($249.95), Study Guide + Calculations + NEC ($279.95), Super Combo ($349.95), Ultimate Combo ($399.95, adds the online test success kit).

## Facts for answering questions

- Every package includes the 2026 state exam prep study guide (12 practice exams + 2 full final exams).
- Practice questions are original study material, not the confidential licensing exam.
- Physical books ship from 1 Exam Prep; online kits are delivered by email.
- Buying does not grant exam eligibility; state licensing boards decide that.
- Store: https://1examprep.com. Phone: (877) 775-9400. Email: sales@1examprep.com.
